build_patch_camelyon_dataset: build a TensorFlow dataset builder for PatchCamelyon medical image data with train, validation, and test splits
create_builder_info: create dataset metadata with image features, class labels, and homepage URL for PatchCamelyon
generate_patch_camelyon_splits: generate train, validation, and test splits from HDF5 files downloaded from Zenodo
